"Hello my new subordinates, my name is Karryn, your new chief warden. Just a few minutes ago I acted as the imperial secretary, and now I have to spend the unforeseeable future in this filthy hole. Karryn first refused, but after being called out for not being up to the challenge, she swiftly changed her mind because of her bruised ego.
